description: This file defines classes related to runtime statistics for a silo in Orleans, including snapshot data for resource usage, message counts, and grain statistics.

classes.name: SiloRuntimeStatistics
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of current runtime statistics for a silo, including resource usage, message counts, and overload status.

classes.name: SimpleGrainStatistic
classes.description: Represents a simple snapshot of grain activation count for a specific grain type on a silo.

classes.name: DetailedGrainStatistic
classes.description: Provides detailed statistics for a specific grain, including its type, silo address, and grain ID.

classes.name: DetailedGrainReport
classes.description: Contains detailed report information for a grain, including addresses, silo info, and class type.

methods.name: SiloRuntimeStatistics.ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current runtime statistics for debugging or logging.

methods.name: SimpleGrainStatistic.ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the grain's simple statistics.

methods.name: DetailedGrainReport.ToString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string report of the grain's information and addresses.
